scripts.dev: sh -c 'npm run dev:backend:api & npm run dev:backend:worker & wait'
scripts.dev:backend:api: cd .. && sh -c 'if [ ! -x ./.venv/bin/python ]; then python3 -m venv .venv; fi; if ! ./.venv/bin/python -c "import pymongo" >/dev/null 2>&1; then ./.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt; fi; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 ./.venv/bin/uvicorn --app-dir backend server:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload'
scripts.dev:backend:worker: cd .. && sh -c 'if [ ! -x ./.venv/bin/python ]; then python3 -m venv .venv; fi; if ! ./.venv/bin/python -c "import pymongo" >/dev/null 2>&1; then ./.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt; fi; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 ./.venv/bin/python backend/recognition_worker.py'
